scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the invariant two-parameter product-metric family on S^2 x S^2. It does not assert a first integral or an exact nonlinear stability rate for general metrics. The proof starts from the product ODE stated in the primary preprint and derives the first integral, extinction time, and anisotropy law analytically. A symbolic checker replays all new identities and asymptotic coefficients.
title: Exact first integral and extinction law for the \(S^2\times S^2\) \(J\)-flow
